description: Split from fz-mue.12 (Amendment 2, approved by the user, relayed by Elixir Parity 2026-11-20). Macro.expand/2 expands a quoted macro call against a %Macro.Env{} (the caller's) until it is no longer a macro call, as Elixir does. fz-p8p.25 (var!/2) uses it to expand its context alias. Owner: Elixir Parity.

comments.text: Commit 2 scope (EP): a dynamic M.__info__(:macros) call inside a macro body fails with internal/unresolved-wait and no source line. Repro: ../fz-otp-json/probes/mue51/r1.fz. Commit 1 (user decision): undecidable macro-ness raises the named 'not supported yet' error; calls env proves are not macros return unchanged; commit 2's replay removes the error.
Commit 1 merged as #889 at 6a246c182 (2026-11-24). Ticket stays open for commit 2 (dynamic __info__(:macros) replay), per the user's two-commit decision.

title: Macro.expand/2 expands a quoted macro call in the caller's environment, as in Elixir
